strategy.summary: The strategy for the Articulations project focuses on developing an integrated solution for music composers, allowing quick control with minimal user configuration. The project includes the Articulate app, which is designed to display instrument articulations and facilitate automation in digital audio workstations. The official release is planned for March 2020, with promotional pricing set at $US 79.
key_points: The Articulations app provides users with access to all their articulations and key switches from a single interface.
Articulate is designed to give music composers quick control with minimal user configuration.
The app allows users to store selected articulations as automation in their digital audio workstation.
Montreal Music Labs is developing the Articulate app as an integrated AU/VST/AAX plugin and touchscreen solution.
The official release of Articulate is scheduled for March 2020, with introductory promo pricing available.
